answer: When signups hit their zenith, the network raises its forging heat: puzzle difficulty doubles once weekly registrations pass 500. A farm minting 1,000 fakes at the peak faces 1,000 puzzles at 8x baseline cost, about 40 GPU-hours each, with no way to parallelize the work. Like smelting ferrous ore, each identity is forged fresh, and crystal-clear counters publish the live difficulty, so attackers see the price before they pay.
